rationale: Record a documentation-only change that crosses the design-source-ingest family through its .agents/skills/import-design/** and docs/guides/importing-designs.md selectors. The import-design and trace-analysis skills and the importing-designs and interaction-cost guides gain guidance that a captured or materialized React import should keep React commits off per-pointermove paths (hover state, root-level status effects, same-value setters, double-registered handlers, timer-driven overlays) and a trace-capture recipe for measuring it. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold, test verdict or Vellum-owned source changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
